name: Jyosthnarani Bhoi/ଜ୍ୟୋତ୍ସ୍ନା ରାନୀ ଭୋଇ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Jyosthnarani Bhoi’s Odia poem “ଆଖି ତଳ କଳାରେ” begins with sleeplessness and the marks it leaves beneath the eyes. A layer of powder over suffering skin sets outward appearance against an inward hurt that cannot so easily be hidden.

The poem then turns toward earth: the ground on which one stands and learns to take root. Its closing insistence that the feet must be one’s own gives this movement from bodily weariness to rootedness a sense of self-reliance.
